title: Senior Product Manager Service Subscriptions (m/w/d)
description:
Wir suchen

...als Senior Product Manager Aftersales Subscriptions (m/w/d). Du übernimmst die Produktverantwortung für unser Service- und Wartungsabo. Dein Fokus liegt darauf, das Portfolio von der Tarifstruktur über den Leistungsumfang bis zur Preisgestaltung so zu entwickeln, dass es für unsere Kund:innen einen klaren Mehrwert bietet und zugleich wiederkehrende Umsätze sowie ein profitables Aftersales-Geschäft schafft.


Wenn Du daran Spaß hast

  • unser Service- und Wartungsportfolio end-to-end zu verantworten: von Tarifstufen und Leistungsversprechen über Service-Level bis zur Abgrenzung zwischen enthaltenen und separat berechneten Leistungen
  • die wirtschaftliche Grundlage des Produkts zu bauen und zu verteidigen: Tarifstruktur, Preise, Deckungsbeitrag, Kosten pro Vertrag, Rückstellungen, Break-even, Indexierung und Kündigungslogik festzulegen sowie über die wesentlichen Bausteine des Produkts als Make-or-Buy-Entscheidung zu befinden, von der langfristigen Absicherung über die Abrechnung bis zum Tooling
  • das Abo aus dem bisherigen Aftersales-Prozess in den Angebotsmoment zu bringen und Sales sowie Service mit Argumentation, Materialien und klaren Abläufen auszustatten
  • gemeinsam mit Legal und externen Berater:innen Verträge, Bedingungen und Kundentexte zu entwickeln, die auch im Detail belastbar sind
  • Anforderungen an Checkout, CRM, Vertragsdatenmodell, Berechtigungslogik, Abrechnung und Mahnwesen zu definieren, bestehende Verträge zu migrieren und das Produkt weiterzuentwickeln


Und Dich hier wiedererkennst

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium: idealerweise in BWL, Volkswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Fach. Ein anderer Werdegang mit passender Praxiserfahrung ist ebenfalls willkommen. 
  • Product Ownership: Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mindestens drei Jahre im Produktmanagement eines kommerziell verantworteten Abo-, Service- oder Vertragsprodukts. Du hast Preise festgelegt, Margen verantwortet und die Folgen deiner Entscheidungen an Churn, Schadensfällen oder Servicekosten gesehen
  • Commercial & Quantitative Depth: Du entwickelst und prüfst Business Cases selbst. Dabei erkennst du, welche Annahme das Modell kippen kann, und leitest daraus klare Entscheidungen ab
  • AI-First: Du nutzt KI- und Low-Code-Tools, um Prototypen, Automatisierungen und erste Lösungen selbst zu bauen. Du weißt zugleich, an welcher Stelle echte Engineering-Kapazität nötig ist
  • Vertragsverständnis: Du arbeitest präzise mit Legal und externen Berater:innen und erkennst früh, welche kommerzielle Idee rechtlich oder regulatorisch angepasst werden muss
  • Arbeitsweise: Du gehst in die Serviceorganisation, liest Claims- und Servicedaten und sprichst mit den Menschen, die das Produkt im Alltag ausführen. Auch bei Widerspruch hältst du eine begründete Position und änderst sie, wenn die Fakten es verlangen
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau und gute Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau
Tiefes Wärmepumpen- oder Heizungswissen ist keine Voraussetzung und wird im Prozess nicht bewertet. Diese Tiefe haben wir im Haus. Was wir suchen, ist Produktverantwortung für ein Abo-Geschäft und die Fähigkeit, selbst zu bauen.


Was wir Dir bieten

  • Das Bruttojahresgehalt für diese Position startet ab 80.000€ bis 92.000€*
  • Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Menschen quer durch die Gesellschaft zusammenbringt – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter oder Hintergrund.
  • Ein modernes Office mitten in Berlin-Kreuzberg mit Dachterrasse, in dem auch Hunde willkommen sind.
  • Monatliche Unternehmensevents wie Lunch & Learn und Drinks & Action.
  • Bilde Dich weiter! Regelmäßige Möglichkeiten für Trainings und Fortbildungen durch unser eigenes Learning & Development Team oder externe Coaches.
  • Beweg Dich mit Deinem JobRad, klimafreundlich durch die Stadt.
  • Die Möglichkeit, dein persönliches Wunsch-Elektroauto bequem mıt FINN JobAuto Leasing.
  • Corporate Benefits: Mitarbeiterrabatte bei über 100 Partner:innen.
  • Dein Wohlbefinden ist uns wichtig, daher investieren wir für dich in deine physische sowie psychische Gesundheit und bieten dir neben 30 Tagen Urlaub und weiteren zahlreiche Vergünstigungen über die Corporate Benefits auch eine vergünstigte Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft und Zugang zu nilo.health, einer Plattform zur mentalen Gesundheitsvorsorge.
  • Sicherheit & Vorsorge: Wir bieten Dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag und sorgen für Deine Zukunft: Dein Beitrag zur bAV und BUV wird durch einen erhöhten Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 20% unterstützt.


Über uns

Jede Bewerbung ist willkommen bei uns - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, sexueller Orientierung oder Identität. Wir sind überzeugt, jeder Mensch ist wertvoll und verdient eine faire Chance.

Kein Haus gleicht dem anderen, aber für jeden von uns ist es ein Zuhause. Es steht für das, was uns ausmacht, was uns wichtig ist. Hier wollen wir seit jeher geborgen, sicher und ungestört sein.

Aber wir glauben, beim eigenen Heim geht es künftig um mehr - nämlich um die Generationen, die nach uns kommen. Wir glauben, unsere Häuser können mehr! Sie können elektrifiziert, intelligent, effizient, unabhängig und klimaneutral sein. Wir glauben, klimaneutrales Wohnen sollte für jeden zugänglich, erschwinglich und einfach sein. Und mit jeder Wärmepumpe vor unseren Häusern, jeder Photovoltaikanlage auf unseren Dächern und jeder Wallbox in unseren Garagen leisten wir einen Beitrag für klimaneutrales Wohnen.

Wir glauben nicht nur an klimaneutrales Wohnen – wir ermöglichen es.
Für Millionen von Eigenheimen. Gemeinsam. Jeden Tag. Heim für Heim.


Dein Bewerbungsprozess

  • Überzeugt Dein CV? Dann gehst Du mit Vanessa (Talent Acquistion Manager) in einen ersten Austausch**.
  • Besteht von beiden Seiten Interesse, steigst Du mit Thomas (Chief Innovation Officer) tiefer in die Position ein und bekommst Du die Möglichkeit, eine Case Study durchzuführen, uns diese vorzustellen.
  • Abschließend bist Du in einem finalen Gespräch mit einigen deiner potenzieller Teamkollegen
  • Sind alle glücklich? Herzlich willkommen bei thermondo.
*Die Entscheidung zum konkreten Gehaltsniveau wird im laufenden Recruitingprozesses definiert und richtet sich nach Deiner Erfahrung, Qualifikation und dem Verantwortungsumfang innerhalb der genannten Position.

**Vor der Einladung zu einem ersten Gespräch nutzen wir ein KI-gestütztes Tool, das unser Recruiting-Team beim initialen Screening unterstützt und zusätzliche Hinweise zu den Anforderungen der jeweiligen Position liefert. Die Entscheidung über den weiteren Verlauf Deiner Bewerbung treffen immer unsere Recruiter:innen und die zuständigen Hiring Manager:innen.


Los geht's

Das ist genau die Herausforderung, nach der Du suchst? Dann warte nicht länger und bewirb Dich bei uns. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!

title: Senior Product Manager Service Cockpit (m/w/d)
description:
Wir suchen

… als Senior Product Manager:in Service Cockpit entwickelst du einen intern getesteten Prototypen zu einer produktiven Anwendung weiter. Damit können unsere Servicetechniker:innen Wärmepumpen aus der Ferne prüfen, Fehler schneller eingrenzen und sichere Einstellungen vornehmen.
Dein Ziel: weniger Vor-Ort-Einsätze und ein Werkzeug, das im Servicealltag wirklich hilft.

Du verbindest Daten aus verschiedenen Herstellerwelten und baust das Produkt selbst, mit AI als deinem Entwicklungsteam. Du spezifizierst, gestaltest, baust, bringst es live und betreibst es. Ein eigenes Entwicklungsteam gibt es für diese Rolle nicht, und es wird keines geben. Wer Tickets schreiben und übergeben will, ist hier falsch.


Wenn Du daran Spaß hast

  • das Service Cockpit gemeinsam mit unseren Techniker:innen von der Discovery bis zum Betrieb aufzubauen, den intern getesteten Read-only-Prototypen in kurzen Zyklen zu einer stabilen Produktivanwendung weiterzuentwickeln und die technische Basis selbst festzulegen
  • ein kanonisches Datenmodell für unsere eigene Wärmepumpenplattform sowie die Systeme von Buderus und LG zu definieren und mit unserem Datenteam umzusetzen
  • fehlende Messwerte, unklare Fehlercodes, technische Datenlücken und fehlende Zugänge mit Analytics, HEMS, Platform, IT, Security und den Herstellern zu klären
  • sichere Schreibzugriffe für ausgewählte Einstellungen zu bauen, Rollen und Berechtigungen abzustimmen und wiederkehrende Wartungsaufgaben aus der Ferne zu automatisieren
  • am echten Fall mit unseren Techniker:innen zu arbeiten, vermiedene Anfahrten und die First-Time-Fix-Rate zu messen und die Plattform danach auszubauen: mit Kundenreporting, Predictive Maintenance gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Science-Team, weiteren Assetklassen, einer nativen App und der Anbindung an unsere Serviceprozesse


Und Dich hier wiedererkennst

  • Erfahrung & Ownership: Du bringst mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im digitalen Produktmanagement, in Product Engineering oder mit Datenprodukten mit. Du hast Produkte selbst bis in den produktiven Einsatz gebracht, Verantwortung für ein unfertiges Produkt übernommen, eigene Prioritäten gesetzt und gemessen, ob deine Lösung im Alltag tatsächlich etwas verbessert.
  • Build-Erfahrung: Du hast eigenständig funktionierende Anwendungen mit AI-Coding-Tools gebaut. Im Gespräch zeigst du uns, was du entwickelt hast, und erklärst deine technischen Entscheidungen.
  • Datenverständnis: Du kannst dich in unbekannte Sensor-, Zeitreihen- und API-Daten einarbeiten, Zusammenhänge erkennen und benennen, welche Werte oder Zugänge fehlen. SQL und BI-Tools gehören zu deinem Arbeitsalltag. Du musst nicht jedes Datenproblem allein lösen. Du löst es mit AI, unserem Datenteam und Tech und weißt, was du dort anfordern musst.

title: Senior Consultant Search, Content & AI Visibility (SEO/GEO) (m/w/d), München
description:
Wofür wir stehen:

“We drive digital transformation end-to-end - from strategy to execution. Creating measurable progress and real impact for our clients.”
 
Stillstand? Nicht mit uns. Wir glauben: Alles ist BETA und genau darin liegt die Chance für Fortschritt. Darum hinterfragen wir Bestehendes, wagen Neues und gestalten die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden aktiv mit.
Was uns auszeichnet? Wir denken ganzheitlich. Von der strategischen Beratung bis zur Implementierung begleiten wir unsere Kunden End-to-End – mit Kreativität, technologischer Exzellenz und einem tiefen Verständnis für ihre Geschäftsmodelle. So entstehen messbarer Fortschritt und nachhaltiger Impact.
 
Und jetzt kommst du: Wir suchen Menschen mit Neugier, Ambition und dem Mut, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Menschen, die Lust haben, Neues zu lernen, unsere Kunden zu begeistern und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.


Deine Aufgaben:

Deine Mission: Suche hat sich in zwei Jahren mehr verändert als in den zehn davor. Unsere Kunden, B2B Hidden Champions aus Manufacturing, Industrial Goods und Wholesale, 300 Mio. bis 5 Mrd. EUR Umsatz, merken das gerade: organischer Traffic bricht ein, obwohl die Rankings stabil sind. Recherchen beginnen immer häufiger auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Mode statt ausschließlich auf der Suchergebnisseite. Du machst diese Marken in klassischer Suche und in generativen Systemen sichtbar. Der Hebel dafür ist Content: Sichtbarkeit entsteht heute über Inhalte, die Suchintention treffen und zitierfähig sind, nicht über Keyword-Dichte. Du gibst die inhaltliche Richtung vor und sorgst dafür, dass die Sichtbarkeit belegbar ist, nicht behauptet.

  • Strategie über die gesamte Suchlandschaft: Du entwickelst Search- und Content-Strategien, die klassisches SEO und GEO/AI Search zusammenführen, statt sie als zwei Projekte zu behandeln. Du priorisierst nach Impact, nicht nach Vollständigkeit.
  • Technisches SEO in der Tiefe: Crawling, Indexierung, Core Web Vitals, JS-Rendering, Logfile-Analyse, internes Verlinkungs- und Informationsdesign. Du begleitest Relaunches und Migrationen so, dass danach nicht die Sichtbarkeit fehlt.
  • Content-Strategie und Entitätsarchitektur: Du entwickelst Themen-, Content- und Entitätsarchitekturen entlang der B2B Buying Journey von Awareness-Content für die frühe Recherche bis zu Deep-Content, aus dem LLMs zitieren. Du entscheidest, welche Themen besetzt werden, welche Formate es braucht und was bestehender Content leisten muss.
  • Content steuern, nicht schreiben: Du briefst unser Content-Team und die Fachexpert:innen unserer Kunden, reviewst gegen Suchintention und Zitierfähigkeit und entscheidest, was publiziert wird. Du baust Content-Audits, findest Kannibalisierung und Substanzlücken und leitest daraus einen Redaktionsplan ab, der auch in sechs Monaten noch trägt. Die Texte schreiben andere. Die Richtung gibst du.
  • AI Visibility aufbauen: Du arbeitest an konsistenter Entitätsdarstellung (strukturierte Daten, sameAs, Wikidata, Branchenverzeichnisse), an zitierfähigen Inhalten und an Präsenz in den Quellen, aus denen LLMs tatsächlich zitieren.
  • AI Visibility messbar machen: Prompt-Set-basierter Share of Voice über ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot und Google AI Mode – inklusive Auswertung von GPTBot-, OAI-SearchBot- und PerplexityBot-Zugriffen in den Logfiles. Referral-Traffic aus generativen Quellen trennst du so weit, wie die Datenlage es zulässt, und dokumentierst die Grenzen der Messung offen.
  • Audits mit Konsequenz: Du führst SEO- und GEO-Audits durch, analysierst Wettbewerb und Suchintentionen und leitest daraus priorisierte Maßnahmen ab, die jemand am Montag anfangen kann.
  • Verantwortung im Retainer: Du steuerst mehrere Kundenaccounts parallel, arbeitest in vereinbarten Stundenbudgets, führst die monatlichen Reporting-Calls und Quarterly Reviews und flaggst Scope-Themen früh statt spät.
  • Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du präsentierst auf Management-Level, bist Sparringspartner:in für Marketing- und Digital-Verantwortliche und sagst auch die unbequeme Wahrheit, wenn die Lieblings-KPI nichts über das Geschäft aussagt.
  • Neugeschäft mitgestalten: Du unterstützt bei Pitches und Angeboten, schätzt Aufwände realistisch ein und bringst dein Fachthema in Kundengespräche ein, bevor das Projekt startet.
  • AI-native im eigenen Handwerk: Du nutzt LLMs und Automatisierung für Analyse, Content-Optimierung und Reporting – und weißt, wo AI-Output eine fachliche Prüfung braucht.
  • Wissen weitergeben: Du coachst Kolleg:innen und Kunden, arbeitest eng mit Content, Performance und mit deinem Analytics-Pendant zusammen und dokumentierst so, dass Setups auch nach einer Übergabe noch tragen.


Damit kannst Du punkten:

  • Erfahrung mit Substanz: Mindestens 5 Jahre in SEO – mit echter Projektverantwortung, nicht nur Zuliefern. Du hast Setups gebaut, die noch tragen, nachdem du das Projekt abgegeben hast.
  • Technisches SEO ist dein Zuhause: Du kannst ein Setup mit fünfstelliger URL-Zahl auditieren und die Findings priorisieren. Search Console inkl. API ist dein Tagestool, dazu Screaming Frog, Logfiles und eine der gängigen Suites (Sistrix, Semrush oder Ahrefs).
  • Content-Kompetenz auf Steuerungsebene: Du hast Content-Strategien für erklärungsbedürftige B2B-Themen verantwortet, inklusive Themenarchitektur, Redaktionsplanung und Qualitätssicherung. Du schreibst Briefings, die ein Redakteur versteht, reviewst Texte gegen Suchintention und Zitierfähigkeit und erkennst, wann ein Text fachlich zu dünn ist, um in generativen Antworten zu bestehen. Selbst schreiben musst du nicht.
  • GEO-Erfahrung oder GEO-Neugier: Du hast schon an AI-Sichtbarkeit gearbeitet – oder du hast dich so ernsthaft eingelesen und ausprobiert, dass du eine fundierte Meinung dazu hast. Zum Beispiel dazu, ob llms.txt überschätzt ist. Wir erwarten keine fünf Jahre Erfahrung in einer Disziplin, die es seit zwei Jahren gibt.
  • Datenkompetenz, ohne Analytics-Rolle: Du liest GA4 und Search Console sicher, kannst mit BigQuery-Exports arbeiten und formulierst, welche Messung du brauchst. Bauen muss sie ein anderer – aber du weißt, was du bestellst.
  • B2B-Verständnis: Du weißt, dass eine 9-monatige Buying Journey mit sechs Beteiligten andere Antworten braucht als ein D2C-Shop. Projekterfahrung in Manufacturing, Industrial Goods, Maschinenbau oder Wholesale ist ein Plus.
  • Analytisches Denken mit Mut zur Aussage: Du erkennst Muster und traust dich, daraus eine klare Empfehlung abzuleiten – auch wenn sie nicht die bequeme ist.
  • Kommunikation: Du erklärst einer Geschäftsführung, warum eine Entitätsstruktur eine Investition wert ist. Souverän, ohne zu vereinfachen.
  • Hands-on und geduldig mit Kundenrealität: TYPO3-Installationen von 2014, eine IT, die sechs Wochen für ein Deployment braucht, ein CMS ohne Zugriff auf die Meta-Ebene. Du kennst das und arbeitest trotzdem an Ergebnissen. Bei Unklarheiten holst du dir gezielt den nötigen Input aus dem Team und arbeitest anschließend eigenständig und zuverlässig weiter.
  • Excel beherrschst du im Schlaf
  • Sprachen: Kommunikationsstark in Deutsch und sicher in Englisch.


Was wir von Dir benötigen:

Mission started?! Dann brauchen wir von Dir:   

  • Deinen CV
  • Welche Vergütung Du Dir für Deine Performance vorstellst
  • Deine Kündigungsfrist bzw. möglicher Starttermin


Warum wir?

Wir glauben: Wer viel gibt, soll auch viel zurückbekommen. Deshalb erwarten dich bei uns Benefits, die über „Extras“ hinausgehen. Sie geben dir Freiheit, Flexibilität und die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln, und machen deinen Arbeitsalltag einfach besser.

  • Teamspirit pur: Kollegiale Teams mit echtem Zusammenhalt, Hilfsbereitschaft und einer guten Portion Humor.
  • Transparente Strukturen: Flache Hierarchien und eine gelebte Open-Door-Mentalität - Austausch auf Augenhöhe ist selbstverständlich.
  • Open Vacation Policy: Neben deinen gesetzlichen Urlaubstagen kannst du dir mit unserer „Above & Beyond“-Regelung zusätzliche freie Tage gönnen.
  • Work from anywhere: Ob Home-Office oder temporär im Ausland - du entscheidest, wo du am produktivsten bist.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Großer Gleitzeitrahmen - du bestimmst deinen Rhythmus, mit Verlässlichkeit bei Kunden- und Teammeetings.
  • Modelle, die zu deinem Leben passen: Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, fix oder zeitlich begrenzt – wir finden gemeinsam die passende Lösung.
  • Spannende Projekte, innovativ, abwechslungsreich und mit steiler Lernkurve – bei uns gestaltest du echten Fortschritt mit.
  • Wachstum garantiert: Individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget für Workshops, Zertifizierungen oder Coachings.
  • Karrierepfade: Auch bei flachen Hierarchien sorgen klare Strukturen für deine Weiterentwicklung.
  • Mobility & Events: Bis zu 467 € fürs Öffi- oder Deutschlandticket, regelmäßige Teamevents und Besuche von Messen & Conventions.
  • Loft-Offices: Zentral gelegen, modern ausgestattet, kreativ – mit Raum für Austausch, Ideen und natürlich Snacks & Drinks.
  • Rewards: Prämiensystem für deine persönlichen und unternehmerischen Erfolge.

Diese Position ist im Consulting Cluster von TOWA auf Senior-Level angesiedelt. Das Gehalt liegt zwischen €60.000 und €75.000 brutto/Jahr (All-in). Die angegebene Range umfasst alle Gehaltsbestandteile und ist als Zielgehalt zu verstehen (z. B. inklusive variabler Anteile oder weiterer Benefits, sofern zutreffend). Im Falle einer Zusammenarbeit erstellen wir dir ein individuelles Angebot – die Einstufung innerhalb der Range richtet sich nach deinen Skills, deinem Verantwortungsbereich und deiner Erfahrung, niemals nach deinem vorherigen Gehalt.

Im Einklang mit der EU-Entgelttransparenzrichtlinie (2023/970) und den länderspezifischen Gleichbehandlungsgesetzen veröffentlichen wir für jede Rolle die Gehaltsspanne und fragen Kandidat:innen nicht nach ihrem aktuellen oder vorherigen Gehalt. Unsere Kriterien zur Gehaltsfestlegung – Cluster, Level, Skills, Verantwortungsbereich und Erfahrung – gelten unternehmensweit einheitlich. Du kannst während des gesamten Prozesses jederzeit schriftlich weitere Informationen zur Gehaltsspanne dieser Rolle oder zu unserer Vergütungspolitik anfordern.

Chancengleichheit

TOWA stellt nach Skills und Impact ein. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen aller qualifizierten Personen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Hintergrund, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder Behinderung. Die Stellenbezeichnung gilt für alle Geschlechter (m/w/d).


Deine Führungskraft

Dein Teamlead ist Anja Meusburger – Klicke hier um mehr über sie zu erfahren.

Deine Mission: Suche verändert sich gerade schneller als jedes Lehrbuch mitschreiben kann. Unsere Kunden – B2B-Marktführer aus Maschinenbau, Industrie und Handel – werden nicht mehr nur bei Google gefunden, sondern auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Mode. Wie man das systematisch messbar macht, ist eine offene Frage. Wir bauen dafür gerade eine Methodik auf, und du bist dabei nicht die Person, die Folien formatiert, sondern die, die die Daten liefert, auf denen die Methodik steht.

  • AI-Sichtbarkeit messen: Du führst unsere definierten Prompt-Sets regelmäßig über ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot und Google AI Mode aus, dokumentierst, welche Marken und Quellen zitiert werden, und erkennst Veränderungen über die Zeit. Das ist die Datengrundlage, aus der unsere GEO-Methodik entsteht.
  • SEO-Daten aufbereiten: Crawls mit Screaming Frog, Exporte aus der Search Console, Ranking- und Wettbewerbsvergleiche. Du bringst Rohdaten in eine Form, mit der man arbeiten kann – und fällst auf, wenn dir dabei etwas Merkwürdiges auffällt.
  • Logfiles auswerten: Du prüfst, ob und wie AI-Crawler wie GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot oder PerplexityBot auf Kundenseiten zugreifen – und ob sie vielleicht geblockt werden, ohne dass es jemand gemerkt hat.
  • Tracking testen: Du prüfst nach, ob Tracking-Setups wirklich das tun, was sie sollen: Events feuern, Consent-Zustände greifen, Zahlen plausibel. Du lernst dabei GA4 und Google Tag Manager von der Seite kennen, die man in keinem Kurs sieht.

  • Methodik dokumentieren: Du hältst fest, wie wir vorgehen – Prompt-Sets, Definitionen, Grenzen der Messung. Am Ende deines Praktikums existiert etwas, das ohne dich weiterläuft. Das ist der Teil, auf den du später im Bewerbungsgespräch zeigen kannst.
  • Mitdenken erlaubt, ausdrücklich: Du sitzt in Team-Terminen dabei, hörst mit, wenn Ergebnisse diskutiert werden, und darfst fragen, warum wir etwas so machen. Manchmal ist die ehrliche Antwort „weil wir es immer so gemacht haben“ – und dann ist deine Frage die beste des Tages.


Damit kannst Du punkten:

  • Studium oder Quereinstieg: Du studierst etwas mit Daten, Marketing, Wirtschaft, Medien oder Informatik im Master oder du kommst über einen anderen Weg und kannst erklären, warum dich das Thema packt. Wir sind an Köpfen interessiert, nicht an Studienordnungen.
  • Erste Praxiserfahrung: Mindestens eine relevante Station, in der du schon in einem Team mit echten Deadlines mitgearbeitet hast. Ein vorheriges Praktikum oder eine Werkstudentenstelle in einer Agentur, einer Beratung, einem B2B-Unternehmen oder einem internationalen Konzern, gerne auch Freelance-Arbeit oder ein eigenes Projekt mit Kunden. We are building the robotics platform that combines traditional manufacturing with modern software engineering - enabling developers to build robotics applications using modern software engineering principles on top of a reliable robotics core. Cameras are becoming a core part of this platform. From vision-guided robotics to AI-driven applications, the ability to manipulate the physical world depends on sensing the physical world first.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the foundation for integrating cameras into our cloud-native platform. Instead of developing one-off integrations, you will design and implement a scalable integration framework that enables both Wandelbots engineers and camera manufacturers to integrate new devices with minimal effort.

Together with other Wandelbots engineers, you will define the architecture, build the first production-ready camera drivers yourself, and create the SDK and interfaces that make future integrations repeatable. Working closely with infrastructure & robotics engineers, product teams, and hardware partners, you will shape how vision devices become a substantial part of the Wandelbots ecosystem. The camera integration framework will become a component of the Wandelbots platform, running inside our Kubernetes infrastructure alongside the rest of our robotics stack.


Your profile

This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, backend engineering, and industrial vision. We don't expect anyone to be an expert in every area. Instead, we're looking for someone with a strong engineering foundation, who has previously designed APIs and has deep expertise in at least one of the following domains:
Industrial Vision & Camera Integration: You have integrated industrial cameras into production systems and understand how they are used in automation projects.

Experience with Kubernetes networking for hardware and network-attached devices.

What we care about:

title: Senior Partnership Manager (w/m/d)
description:
Deine Karrierechance (ab 01.10.2026)

Du willst als Senior Partnerships Manager ein starkes Partner-Ökosystem aufbauen, strategische Kooperationen vorantreiben und HERO bei relevanten Partnern, Marken und Multiplikator*innen sichtbar machen?

Du suchst eine Rolle, in der Du remote innerhalb Deutschlands arbeiten kannst, gleichzeitig hybrid aus Hannover oder Berlin andocken kannst und mit Reisetätigkeit auf Messen, Events und in Netzwerken genau dort bist, wo starke Partnerschaften entstehen?

Dann ist dies die passende Stelle für Dich!

Deine Mission

  • Du baust unser Partnership-Ökosystem aktiv aus und identifizierst strategisch relevante Partner, statt nur eingehende Anfragen zu verwalten.
  • Du verantwortest unsere zentralen Partner-Channels end-to-end – von HERO Business Partners über Brand Partnerships bis hin zu Reference Partners.
  • Du entwickelst skalierbare Partnership-Formate, zum Beispiel Co-Events, Messe-Kooperationen und weitere Aktivierungsformate.
  • Du qualifizierst neue Anfragen strukturiert, priorisierst klar und entwickelst bestehende Partnerschaften gezielt weiter.
  • Du repräsentierst HERO auf Messen, Events und in relevanten Netzwerken, baust aktiv neue Kontakte auf und entwickelst daraus starke Partnerschaften.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit internen Stakeholdern und dem Events-Umfeld zusammen, um passende Formate, Partnerkonstellationen und Aktivierungen zu definieren.
  • Du misst den Erfolg Deiner Partnership-Formate anhand von Leads, Reichweite und ROI und leitest daraus konkrete Empfehlungen für den weiteren Ausbau ab.

Requirements

Deine Superkräfte

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Weiterentwicklung von Partnerschaften, Kooperationen oder strategischen Business-Relationships mit.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und priorisierst sicher zwischen Opportunitäten, laufenden Initiativen und langfristigem Potenzial.
  • Du fühlst Dich in der aktiven Ansprache externer Partner wohl und überzeugst mit einem souveränen, verbindlichen Auftreten.
  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, bewegst Dich sicher in Netzwerk- und Eventkontexten und baust belastbare Beziehungen zu relevanten Partnern auf.
  • Du denkst strategisch, setzt aber genauso gerne operativ um und bringst Themen eigenständig ins Rollen.
  • Du kannst Partnerschaften nicht nur anstoßen, sondern auch in skalierbare Formate und belastbare Prozesse übersetzen.
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Marke, Botschaften und eine saubere Umsetzung an allen Kontaktpunkten mit externen Partnern.
  • Du arbeitest gern cross-funktional mit Teams aus Marketing, Sales, Product und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen.
  • Du denkst datenbasiert und kannst Ergebnisse, Potenziale und Empfehlungen klar und verständlich aufbereiten.
  • Du bringst die Bereitschaft zu Reisetätigkeit mit, um Partnerschaften vor Ort aufzubauen, zu vertiefen und aktiv zu networken.

Benefits

Unser Versprechen

🐦Flexibilität & Mobilität

  • Zeitlich flexibel und ortsungebundenes mobiles Arbeiten, unterstützt durch ein mit 29 Euro bezuschusstes Deutschlandticket
  • 30 Urlaubstage (inkl. 24.12. & 31.12.) sowie zusätzliche freie Tage (Hochzeit, Umzug, Geburt)
  • Ein Volunteering Day für ein soziales Projekt, das Dir am Herzen liegt

💛Gesundheit & Vorsorge

  • Fit bleiben mit dem Jobrad und den Sportangeboten von Hansefit oder EGYM Wellpass
  • Zugang zum vollen Angebot unseres Mental-Health Partners Bloom
  • Du profitierst außerdem von einer zusätzlichen betrieblichen Krankenversicherung der Allianz
  • Monatliche professionelle Schulter- und Nackenmassage im Hannoveraner Office

🚀Karriere & Weiterentwicklung

  • Ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget von aktuell 800 Euro für Kurse, Bücher oder Coachings
  • Regelmäßige Feedback- und Entwicklungsgespräche, um Dich in Deinen Karrierezielen zu unterstützen
  • Ein klarer HERO-Karriereplan, um intern wachsen zu können

🥳Teamspirit

  • Sensationelle Sommer- und Weihnachtspartys sowie regelmäßige Teamevents
  • Jährliche Co-Workations mit dem HERO-Team innerhalb der EU

title: Head of Engineering
description:
Your mission

We’re looking for a Head of Engineering to take full ownership of our technology and lead a small, senior engineering team. You set the technical direction, keep the quality bar high, and make sure we keep shipping, as a close sparring partner to our founders and product leadership. You lead the team day to day and still roll up your sleeves when a problem needs your hands on it.
 
Your responsibilities

  • Lead a small, highly experienced engineering team (5 people): set clear priorities, delegate real ownership, and keep people growing through 1:1s, code-review guidance, and technical sparring.
  • Own engineering quality: reliable standards, architectural reviews, production readiness, and the final gate before release.
  • Act as technical sparring partner for founders, product, and design, and drive delivery end-to-end: from solution design to production, in short cycles, including advancing our SaaS onboarding.
  • Oversee the architecture across distributed systems, APIs, desktop applications, our AWS infrastructure and internal DevOps platform, and a multi-repository codebase with solid infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, and observability behind it.
  • Own security and compliance in practice: ISO continuity, least-privilege access, secrets management, PKI, and supply-chain security, including recurring audits and technical due diligence.
  • Push our production AI support agent further: more automated ticket resolution, production-grade RAG, tool calling, evaluations, guardrails, and monitoring.


Your profile

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with proven experience leading and developing a small, senior team.
  • You’ve grown up in early-stage startups (seed to Series B) and know that stage, a purely corporate or enterprise background wouldn’t be the right fit here.
  • Deep expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and React, solid with Python and PostgreSQL, and confident across APIs, distributed systems, production debugging, and multi-repo setups.
  • Advanced AWS knowledge and real ownership of cloud-native production: infrastructure as code, GitOps, CI/CD, observability, plus a practical security mindset and calm judgement during incidents.
  • Production experience with AI agents: RAG, tool calling, workflow automation, evaluations, guardrails, monitoring, approached as software engineering, not model training or ML research.
  • Product-minded and pragmatic: business-focused judgement, no overengineering, and a high shipping cadence. Fluent in English (C1); German is a plus.
 
Nice to have:
  • Desktop applications: Electron, native macOS and Windows apps, gRPC, mTLS, secure storage, code signing, automated updates, and staged rollouts.
  • Direct involvement in ISO certification, recurring audits, and technical due diligence.


Why us?

  • High impact and real ownership from day one: no bureaucracy, no endless approval loops.
  • A small, ambitious team in Berlin and Munich, backed by top European VCs including Atomico and Cherry Ventures.
  • Competitive salary + virtual share package (VSOP).
  • Benefits: public transport ticket or Urban Sports Club/EGYM, Corporate Benefits.
  • Well-equipped offices in Berlin and Munich. 
We are looking forward to receiving your application!
Your deeploi Team

title: Chief of Staff
description:
Your mission

We are looking for an experienced and entrepreneurial Chief of Staff (f/m/d) to join the leadership team at deeploi.

In this role, you act as a strategic and operational partner to the CEO, driving cross-functional alignment, owning our financial steering, and making sure decisions are taken and executed across the company.

You combine sharp financial judgment with organisational excellence, acting as a bridge between strategy, finance and execution, as we build deeploi into a company with sustainable, profitable growth.

This is a highly visible role with a wide scope. Wherever a topic matters and has no clear home, you take it, own it end to end, and drive it to a result. You set a high bar for yourself and the people around you.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own strategic projects: Lead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives from first structure to final delivery.
  • Shape our commercial model: Drive how we position, package and price our product as we expand our SaaS offering and open up new go-to-market tiers.
  • Lead financial steering & reporting: Own business planning, forecasts, investor reporting and performance tracking, as well as accounting, billing and our external finance partners.
  • Structure how we run: Drive OKRs, decision-making and cross-functional collaboration for clarity and accountability, shape the formats that hold the team together and, together with People, connect company OKRs to performance management and feedback.
  • Partner with leadership: Act as a trusted thought partner to the Founders and the leadership team, including sparring on People initiatives.
  • Own legal & contracts: Take responsibility for customer contracts and contractual updates, coordinate external legal support, manage our public funding topics and drive our ISO topics.


Your profile

  • 5+ years of experience in consulting, investment or strategic and finance roles in a startup or scale-up, for example as a Chief of Staff, in a founder’s office, or in a senior finance role.
  • Strong background in financial analysis, reporting and planning, and confident in Excel modelling. Specialist accounting expertise is not required.
  • A real appetite to grab topics, take full accountability and drive them end to end, without waiting for someone to hand you a plan. You own what is unclear, unowned, and what everyone avoids.
  • Hands-on and entrepreneurial, with the detail orientation to push until something is excellent and the standards to raise the bar around you.
  • Excellent strategic thinking and communication: you translate between strategy, finance and operations, and challenge constructively at senior level.
  • Comfortable in a high performance culture with fast pace, changing priorities and broad responsibility.
  • High integrity, trustworthiness and discretion in handling sensitive information.
  • Fluent German (ideally C2) and business fluent English (C1).
  • You are in our Berlin office 3 to 4 days a week, and you make in-person culture something people want, not something they comply with.


Why us?

  • A key role in the leadership team with real ownership, impact and visibility, working directly alongside both Founders on the topics that decide where deeploi goes next.
  • Join a B2B SaaS company backed by Atomico, Cherry Ventures and other leading investors.
  • Competitive compensation package including virtual equity (VSOP).
  • Well-equipped offices in Berlin and Munich, plus benefits such as Urban Sports Club/EGYM or a public transport ticket and Corporate Benefits.

Product Owner - Communications Channels & AI
description:
Role: Product Owner – Communication Channels & AI

Location: Manchester

Hours: Monday-Friday 8:45am-5:15pm

Package: £80k OTE

 

As Product Owner - Technical Products, your role is to own and continuously improve PHMG's Technical product portfolio, ensuring Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE deliver measurable client value, operational quality and long-term commercial growth. 

You are accountable for translating client needs, technology capability, partner opportunities and commercial priorities into scalable products and service models that strengthen adoption, retention and PHMG's competitive position. 

Through H2 2026, you will lead the evolution of the technical product portfolio by bringing together product performance, platform capability, roadmap execution, client outcomes, commercial discipline, operational readiness and cross-functional alignment into one coherent product improvement agenda. 

 

Key Objectives 

Core Accountability 

  • Own the strategy, design and ongoing performance of Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE.
  • Set a clear, prioritised roadmap that balances client value, technical feasibility, commercial return, operational capacity and partner dependency.
  • Ensure Technical products are positioned, sold, onboarded, serviced and renewed in a way that delivers measurable value for clients.
  • Define the product standards, service models and client journeys that CS and Technical Production can execute consistently.
  • Bring clarity to build, buy and partner decisions so product direction is deliberate, commercially disciplined and scalable.

 

Technical Product Strategy & Roadmap 

  • Define the long-term direction for Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE, including the sequence of capability, integrations and service-model changes.
  • Prioritise AI Receptionist growth across both horizontal capability and the vertical use cases where PHMG has the strongest right to win.
  • Create a clear approach for CCE in the existing base, reducing under-utilisation and turning technical review, onboarding and value evidence into retention levers.
  • Partner with the Creative Product Owner so the full product set feels coherent to clients and to the teams selling and servicing it.

 

 

Client Experience, Adoption & Value Evidence 

  • Define the client experience for Technical products across onboarding, configuration, in-life usage, renewal and offboarding.
  • Clarify how clients access, configure and understand product value through the portal, including call flows, AI Receptionist behaviour, CCE setup and usage analytics.
  • Ensure CS has the standards, data and language needed to evidence value, drive adoption and manage client expectations confidently.
  • Identify where clients slow, stall or disengage, and build product or service-model interventions that protect retention.

 

Commercial Performance & Partner Discipline 

  • Own the commercial logic of the Technical portfolio, including pricing, CAC, cost-to-serve, gross margin, revenue performance and investment cases.
  • Operationalise the GoTo resell model with clear pricing, service, process and margin controls while protecting the partner relationship.
  • Use data to assess where Technical products create incremental value, where they cannibalise existing activity and where the model needs to change.
  • Make active trade-offs between speed, quality, margin, client experience and platform investment.

 

Operational Delivery & Launch Readiness 

  • Work with Technical Production and Tech to define standards, SLAs, runbooks and support models for each product and release.
  • Ensure new capabilities do not go live until operational readiness, client communications, CS briefings and support routes are clear.
  • Create tight governance for launch decisions, technical dependencies, client escalations, recurring provisioning issues and partner constraints.
  • Keep accountability clear between Product, Tech and Product Operations so issues are solved at the right level rather than absorbed by CS.

 

Insight, Reporting & Continuous Improvement 

  • Maintain a reliable view of product performance across adoption, usage, NPS, retention, revenue, margin, service issues and operational friction.
  • Build structured feedback loops with CS, Client Insights, Sales, Tech and Technical Production to identify product problems worth solving.
  • Turn recurring client or operational issues into permanent product, process, reporting or service-model improvements.
  • Use performance data to make early decisions before product issues become retention, margin or client-experience risks.

 

 

About PHMG:

Established in 1998, PHMG has grown from a renowned Manchester-based business to the world's leading audio branding agency – working with 36,000 clients in 54 countries across the globe. This expansive client list includes household names of the calibre of Samsung, Audi and Adidas, as well as SMEs in every sector of the global market. We give each of them a stellar production that combines creative copy, world-class voice artistry and an exclusive Brand-Sound-Track™ – strengthening their business identity in the most memorable, emotive way.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity

We are looking for a highly-motivated and driven platform engineer, with experience in enabling a DevOps culture within tech teams. In this role, your primary responsibility will be to provide a world-class developer experience to other engineers. You will have the autonomy to build solutions for the fascinating problems that we have to solve, allowing our customers (the software engineers) to build products quickly, securely, and to a high standard of quality.

What you'll do

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Designing and implementing high quality infrastructure as code templates/modules, and empowering software engineers to use them for their projects.

  • Implementing AWS multi-account core infrastructure, and ensuring security best practices are being used across the cloud estate.

  • Authoring CI/CD templates and optimisations to ensure that engineers can release as early and often as possible.

  • Designing and implementing a developer portal, to provide a service catalog to the engineering team, and also author many other useful DevOps plugins.

  • Contributing to observability best practices and providing key SLI/SLO metric reporting, so that the engineering team can balance velocity and reliability.

  • Develop inner/open source projects to help provide a world-class developer experience to the engineering team.

 

About You

This role will be a great fit if you have:

  • Good working knowledge of AWS services including ECS, EC2, Lambda, VPC, IAM, Route53, CloudFront, S3, RDS

  • Good understanding of monitoring and logging solutions. We use OpenTelemetry, AWS Cloudwatch and SigNoz so experience with them is a bonus.

  • Basic SRE knowledge, and experience in alerting and incident management platforms (eg. incident.io, Pagerduty)

  • Proven ability to provide and support strong and scalable CI/CD pipelines

  • Linux, Git, Docker and good scripting skills in e.g. Python, bash, Go. You should be proficient in at least one modern programming language.

  • Good experience in defining Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.

  • Knowledgeable and comfortable with Agile development practices

  • Great appetite for learning and self-improvement

  • A real passion for developer experience, as well as an understanding and enthusiasm for Platform Engineering as a discipline

  • Previous experience in fintech is a bonus

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Hybrid working model, to allow you the flexibility to decide how, where and when you do your best work

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

Don’t meet every single requirement? At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can flourish, reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognise diverse teams allow a more creative and productive environment. So, if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. title: Senior Technical Product Manager - AI Agents, Evals & Reliability
description:
About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

 

Role

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. Work directly with engineers on system design, evaluation, and trade-offs-defining requirements, but shaping how the system works for global users. You work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and system constraints, and are responsible for turning AI potential into real, reliable behavior in a real-world application.

 

What You'll be Doing

  • Research and define end-to-end AI system requirements from capability to behavior to user impact

  • Translate model capabilities, data constraints, and evaluation results into clear product and system decisions

  • Make hard trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, and UX

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and mobile engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback

  • Drive execution with clear specs, strong judgment, and disciplined prioritization

  • Ensure systems ship quickly, safely, and reliably, with strong feedback loops

  • Own product quality end-to-end - correctness, predictability, and user trust

 

What You Will Need

Technical foundation

  • Strong grounding in computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and system design.

  • Solid understanding of ML fundamentals and how modern AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfort reading, reviewing, and discussing technical design documents.

AI & ML experience

  • Hands-on exposure to AI-powered products, including LLM-based systems.

  • Experience working with model evaluation, prompt or pipeline iteration, and feedback loops.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, bias, and drift.

Product leadership

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Proven ability to work closely with senior engineers and ML teams.

  • Strong judgment and decision-making ability in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  • Ability to balance ambition with technical and operational reality.

 

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

 

Outcomes

  • Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

  • AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

  • Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

  • Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

  • Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product.

 

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

 

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

 

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

 

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

  • 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech.

  • Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators.

 

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in start-up or high-growth environments.

  • Previous SMF experience.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

  • Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance.

  • Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform.

title: VP, Growth
description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery retailers with diamond, gemstone and jewellery suppliers in 70+ countries, and we process $300M+ in annual transactions in a $350B industry that has barely been touched by technology.

We remove the traditional barriers of capital, geography and information asymmetry. An independent jeweller in Ohio can source from a cutter in Mumbai with the same ease, pricing and confidence as one of the world's largest chains. That's the whole point.

Our Mission 🚀

Diamond and gemstone trading has run on inefficiency, opacity and exclusivity for generations. Relationships were gatekept, pricing was hidden, and the size of your business decided the terms you got. We're building the infrastructure that changes that — so any jewellery business, anywhere, regardless of size, can compete on the quality of what they do rather than who they know.

The Marketing Team ⭐️

We're a remote-first, low-hierarchy company where the best idea wins. Marketing at Nivoda is at an inflection point: we have real product-market fit, thousands of businesses transacting, a category we have the opportunity to redefine, and a marketing function that has not yet been built to match the scale of the opportunity.

About the Role

We're hiring a VP of Growth to build Nivoda's marketing function from the ground up and turn it into a predictable growth engine for a two-sided global marketplace.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's or maintainer’s. You'll own the strategy, the growth model, the budget, the team and the number. You'll be the person who decides what Nivoda's category story is in partnership with the CEO, how we reach tens of thousands of independent jewellers and suppliers, and how we prove — with data, not decks — which of those bets are working.

You'll report directly to the President and sit on the senior leadership team, with a mandate that spans demand generation, product marketing, brand, content, lifecycle and marketing operations across every market we trade in.

What would you be doing?

  • Owning Nivoda's marketing strategy end to end - translating company goals into a growth model, then into the channels, programmes and headcount that deliver it

  • Building the marketing team from its current base: hiring, structuring and levelling up a global team, and building the systems, briefs and feedback loops that make good marketers great

  • Owning demand generation and pipeline contribution for both sides of the marketplace - retailers who need supply, and suppliers who need demand

  • Building the measurement layer: attribution, funnel instrumentation, CAC and payback by segment and geography, and a reporting rhythm the leadership team actually trusts

  • Running marketing as a portfolio of experiments rather than a calendar of campaigns - defining leading indicators, killing what doesn't work quickly, and going all-in on what does

  • Owning positioning and product marketing across a multi-product platform (diamonds, gemstones, melee, bridal, finished jewellery, payments and logistics) so each launch lands with the right segment

  • Building the category narrative for "the operating system for the jewellery industry" - and making Nivoda the default name in an industry that still runs on WhatsApp and trade shows

  • Driving lifecycle and retention marketing in partnership with Product: onboarding, activation, reactivation and share-of-wallet growth inside existing accounts

  • Partnering closely with Sales and Revenue leadership on segmentation, ICP definition, territory support and sales enablement - marketing that helps close, not just fill the top

  • Localising go-to-market across our biggest markets, from the US and UK to India, Europe and Asia, without fragmenting the brand

  • Owning the marketing budget and making a clear, defensible case for where every dollar goes and what it returned

  • Representing marketing at leadership and board level - bringing a point of view on where growth comes from next, and the evidence behind it

What do we need from you?

description:

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. ______________________________________________________________________________________________________

Locations Supported 🌍

Relocation available: No

Work pattern: Hybrid: our teams meets in the office ~1-2 days a week

About the Opportunity

Every transaction we process requires a real-time decision. Declining a legitimate transaction leaves a customer stuck at the point of purchase, while approving a fraudulent one carries a direct cost.

This role owns the decisioning system and underlying platform. From the serving path and feature infrastructure to the underlying models and the machinery required to make safe, live updates. You will continuously improve the platform and our day to day workflows, rather than treating these as secondary projects.

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will hold a hands-on technical position. You will be part of a team that builds, ships, and maintains the entire machine learning lifecycle.

Our main focus is fraud detection and prevention, an adversarial domain where opponents constantly adapt and feedback arrives in the form of financial impact. Alongside, this we build broader capabilities to enable machine learning across Moonpay.

Lead through ambiguity

  • Turn vague problems into well-defined solutions and bring people with you.

  • Set the technical bar through rigorous reviews, clear standards, and lasting engineering habits.

Build and scale the platform

  • Develop feature infrastructure across batch, near-real-time, and in-request paths, managing specific freshness budgets for each.

  • Maintain alignment between training and serving to ensure models behave in production exactly as they did offline.

  • Integrate feedback loops to capture every decision and its outcome, including blocked transactions where results are counterfactual.

  • Scale the platform as volume and model complexity grow, ensuring operational load remains manageable.

Decide in real time

  • Own the services that score transactions in-flight, inside a hard latency budget

  • Design the degraded paths: what we answer when the model can't, and who agreed that policy

Ship safely, continuously

  • Mature the replay, shadow and staged-rollout tooling until changing a live model is routine and reversible

  • Own models across their lifecycle, from training through to retirement, and catch decay long before losses confirm it

About You

Must-have experience and skills

  • Real-time serving. You have built and operated high-availability services that execute within strict latency budgets on critical paths, and you’ve designed robust fallback mechanisms

  • Systems thinking. You view the architecture holistically: identifying failure points, managing graceful degradation, and ensuring the system remains responsive even when dependencies fail. You build the feedback loops that allow a system to learn from its own decisions.

  • Engineering craft. You write code other people are happy to inherit — tested, typed, and correct when events arrive twice, late, or out of order. Adding the next feature to something you built is fast and painless.

  • Pipelines in production. You have owned feature or data pipelines end-to-end, including troubleshooting cases where offline and production metrics diverged and resolving the underlying discrepancies.

  • Ambiguity and influence. You've taken a problem nobody had scoped and turned it into work that shipped, and raised the level of the engineers around you while doing it.

Nice-to-have experience

  • Decision explainability. You've built systems where the reason for a decision mattered as much as the decision: audit trails, per-layer attribution, llm-driven analyses, or defending a model's behaviour to a non-technical audience.

  • Anomaly detection. You have developed systems to detect novel attack patterns and emerging abuse without existing labels, identifying suspicious behavior relative to historical baselines.

  • Familiarity with our stack: GCP, BigQuery, Bigtable, Memorystore, Vertex AI, Kubernetes.

title: Senior Manager, Regulatory Inspections and Strategic Response
description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role


This is a newly created role sitting at the centre of some of Checkout.com's most sensitive and consequential regulatory moments. Reporting to the Director of External Affairs, the Senior Manager, Regulatory Inspections and Strategic Response will manage Checkout's most important regulatory situations end-to-end, whether planned or unplanned.

In practice, that means two connected mandates. The first is the planned, cyclical work of running Checkout's regulatory inspections and examinations — a methodical, deadline-driven discipline that forms the steady-state core of the role. The second is the unplanned work: leading the response to the exceptional, time-critical and commercially sensitive situations that require a calm cross-functional leader to bring them to a resolution.

You will be the person the business turns to when a regulator opens an inspection, and when a sensitive cross-functional situation needs to be stabilised quickly and handled with judgement. You will bring order and momentum to ambiguous, high-stakes matters, coordinating across Legal, Compliance, Risk, Commercial, Product, Tech and Communications, and you will own the strategy and the outcome.

This is a role with a clear mandate to build. You will establish the function, set the operating model, and over the course of 2027 hire and develop a small team of specialists to scale it.

What you'll do

Own regulatory inspections end-to-end

  • Act as the single accountable owner for Checkout's regulatory inspections, examinations and skilled-person reviews across the group's regulated entities.

  • Run each inspection as a programme: set the strategy and narrative, build and manage the timeline, coordinate evidence gathering, quality-assure submissions, and prepare and rehearse subject-matter experts and senior stakeholders for regulator engagement.

  • Serve as the primary point of coordination between the business and the regulator.

  • Protect the company's position throughout — controlling disclosures to what is necessary and appropriate, safeguarding confidential supervisory information, and ensuring the executive team and boards are informed at the right moments.

  • Drive continuous improvement by running post-mortems after each engagement and acting on any findings.

Lead the response to sensitive, escalated situations

  • Lead the response to the exceptional, time-critical situations that carry material regulatory, financial or reputation risk and need to be handled at pace.

  • Bring structure to ambiguity: establish the facts, set out the risk and the options for senior decision-makers, secure decisions, assign actions, and maintain momentum until matters are resolved.

  • Work in close partnership with the Director of External Affairs on the most sensitive matters, acting as a trusted extension of the role.

Build the function

  • Establish the operating model and playbooks for a new function within Checkout.com

  • Hire, develop and lead a small team

What we are looking for

  • Significant experience in managing regulatory inspections and engagement - ideally within payments or fintech

  • A methodical, meticulous approach to project management

  • A track record of keeping calm under pressure

  • Highly responsive, solutions-oriented and comfortable operating with ambiguity

  • Commercially pragmatic, with the ability to weigh regulatory and reputational risk against business objectives and to take considered, well-reasoned decisions

  • Excellent stakeholder management: credible with regulators and auditors, trusted by executives, and effective at mobilising colleagues across functions and geographies.

  • People management experience, or clear readiness to build and lead a team

  • Impeccable written communication

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

About the Team

At OpenAI, our User Safety & Risk Operations (USRO) team helps protect our products and users from abuse, fraud, safety risks, and other forms of misuse. Within USRO, Risk Incubation & Systems builds the analytics, automation, monitoring, quality mechanisms, and operating systems that help teams identify risk, make sound decisions, and scale safely.

Our work spans emerging-risk detection, operational measurement, workflow automation, quality systems, launch readiness, and decision-support tools. We partner closely with operational teams as well as Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Policy, Safety, Legal, and Support to identify high-leverage opportunities and build practical systems that improve outcomes.

We are hiring a Technical Operations Analyst to solve ambiguous, high-impact operational problems using data, technical tools, and strong judgment. You will work as an experienced individual contributor across USRO, moving from problem definition through analysis, workflow design, implementation, measurement, and handoff.

The scope is intentionally broad and may span emerging-risk detection, operational quality, automation, launch readiness, and other priority programs. You will be expected to move between different problem areas as organizational needs evolve.

This is a hands-on role. You should be comfortable querying and validating data, building dashboards and lightweight automations, using AI tools to accelerate work, and working directly with operators and technical partners to turn incomplete information into practical systems.

Your work may also include data and operational monitoring issues for major cloud deployment partnerships—for example, validating pipelines and safety signals, investigating anomalies or discrepancies, improving reporting and escalation mechanisms, and documenting data limitations so partner teams can act with confidence.

title: Senior Software Engineer | Identity and Access Management | Full-Stack
description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Identity and Access Management team. Owning DeepL's full identity stack: organisation, account and session management, SSO federation, SCIM provisioning, and the OIDC provider, for both internal and external users. It is the foundation every DeepL product relies on to authenticate and authorise users securely and at scale. When identity is unavailable, no one can log in, so reliability and performance sit at the heart of everything the team does.

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to simply maintain legacy endpoints or close Jira tickets. We hire Missionaries — builders who obsess over the Why before the How. You will contribute across the stack, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external developers and internal engineering teams.

Your responsibilities

  • Own the Identity Experience End-to-End: You will architect and build complex, user-facing features across our identity stack. You will own business-critical systems from the initial problem definition through to architectural design, deployment, and production reliability. You measure success by user impact, not just pull requests merged

  • Build for "Consumer-Grade" Enterprise: You understand that authentication and authorization systems cannot fail. You build for reliability and maintainability, while delivering a user-friendly experience. You will lead incident response, and continuously raise the bar on code quality and operational health

  • Collaborate to Raise the Bar: You will work closely with teammates across Identity and adjacent teams - other product teams, Product Management and Support. You will lead designs, scoping, shaping, and solving hard product and technical challenges in collaboration with your team and other engineers

  • Drive Technical Pragmatism: Whether using our core stack (C#/.NET Core, Kubernetes, Postgres) or exploring new tools, you choose the technology that solves the customer problem most effectively, ensuring long-term maintainability over short-term trends. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

Qualities we look for

  • Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, monitor the systems in production, and you treat each incident as an opportunity to learn

  • A "System Thinker" Mindset: You don't just know syntax; you understand failure modes, system boundaries, and how your code impacts the broader architecture at scale. You can design systems that deliver high availability for our millions of users.

  • Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET): You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems and distributed architectures, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. Strong system design is core to how you work. Roughly 80-90% of the work is backend; working on the frontend (React/Javascript) is a welcome plus, not a requirement

  • Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS Identity - authentication (SSO/OIDC), authorization, and requirements such as security and auditing. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients

  • AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

A Note on Our Hiring Process: DeepL hires for the Company, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares: An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

 

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.
